value: AdBlock Pro for Safari is a highly trusted and comprehensive ad-blocking extension for Apple devices, including iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Vision Pro. It enhances the browsing experience by effectively eliminating intrusive ads, pop-ups, and autoplay videos, while simultaneously improving privacy by blocking trackers, accelerating page loading speeds, and extending battery life. Operating securely via Apple’s native Content Blocking API, the app ensures user data remains private. Available as a free extension with an optional premium subscription for advanced features like enhanced country-specific blocking and automatic filter updates, AdBlock Pro aims to deliver a faster, cleaner, and more secure web experience.
